journey: SOC2 audit-evidence: published attestation key is the root of trust

narrative.step: fetches the well-known fabric attestation key — deliberately UNAUTHENTICATED (verification bootstrap)
the key endpoint carries NO tenant material — it is region-public, not tenant-scoped
narrative.assertion: key entry shape is {key_id, pubkey_b64, expires_ms=null} — no tenant field (region-public)

narrative.step: CONTRAST control — a tenant DATA surface is NOT public: no PAT → 401 unauthorized
narrative.assertion: GET /v1/usage (no PAT) → 401 code=unauthorized (data is PAT-gated; the key is not)

narrative.step: with a real PAT the evidence surfaces resolve — the substrate the SOC2 report would attest is live
narrative.assertion: authed GET /v1/usage → 200 (evidence surfaces live); records residual

artifact.soc2Report: owner-gated (org-level, not built in this repo)
